description: Auto-generate a storyboard from a script: an LLM splits the script into scenes, then one storyboard frame is generated per scene. COSTS CREDITS — every scene is one generated image, charged up front for the number of scenes the script is split into (at most max_scenes). The per-image price depends on `model`; see lab_list_models. Ask the human before running it. The scene split is SYNCHRONOUS and can take up to ~55s and then time out (504) for long scripts; run it in the app if so. The answer lists the new image ids; the frames themselves render in the background as pending images — poll them with lab_job_status (type 'image').

creativity.description: Krea 2 creativity setting; ignored by flux_pro. Default medium.

max_scenes.description: Upper limit for the number of scenes, and therefore images charged. Backend default when omitted.

model.description: Image model for the frames. Default krea_2_medium. Prices per model: lab_list_models.

script.description: Screenplay or scene description to storyboard. Required — the backend splits it into scenes; each scene becomes one image.

style_reference_url.description: Shared moodboard image applied to ALL frames for one consistent look. Used by the Krea 2 models only. Must be an asset of this project or an absolute URL — anything else is refused before credits are spent.

name: lab_auto_storyboard
title: Auto-Storyboard
